edges.rationale: Removing low-quality samples and duplicates is a foundational step required to ensure data is accurate and free from errors.
Cleaning raw data by removing duplicates and low-quality samples is necessary before assessing whether the dataset represents all necessary scenarios.
The effective volume of usable data can only be determined after low-quality samples and duplicates are removed.
Duplicate entries must be removed before analyzing intersections between data subsets to prevent data leakage.
Ensuring data accuracy and reliability is a prerequisite for meaningfully evaluating whether the dataset represents all necessary scenarios.
Determining the appropriate volume of data is necessary before assessing whether the dataset has sufficient diversity to represent all scenarios.
